answer_1.quote: We curated a large-scale and information-enriched RP training dataset... it contains 41,631 multi-turn dialogues (comprising 206,444 single-turn) and features 18,424 distinct roles...

answer_2.quote: We compare RoleRM with widely used ChatGPT, and three dialogue evaluators, including PairEval, G-Eval, and GPTScore...

answer_3.quote: We used RoleRM to automatically evaluate RP‑LLMs and also employed ChatGPT as an evaluator of generated dialogues...

answer_4.quote: We further conducted an additional human evaluation... new human annotators to rank 423 RP dialogue responses...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators scored each dialogue on a four‑level scale (0‑3) for six criteria: Language Fluency, Language Relevance, Role Language, Role Knowledge, Emotional Expression, Interactive Engagement.
